create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with an autoencoder, discriminators, data loader, and training parameters
run_lat_dis_step: run a training step for the latent discriminator using encoded autoencoder outputs
run_ptc_dis_step: run a training step for the patch discriminator on real and flipped decoded images
run_autoencoder_step: run a training step for the autoencoder combining reconstruction and discriminator losses
run_classifier_step: run a training step for a standalone classifier using attribute prediction loss
